deviations.what: A Card subclass registered as a page or an action is refused, and a card must be built on Card with a template_name or its own render_card. Neither refusal is listed in the tasks.
deviations.why: A card has no address, so a navigation entry for one would name a URL that does not exist and fail while the overview or the navigation is drawn.

deviations.what: Each drawn card is written inside a wrapper element with display: contents and a data-contributed-card attribute.
deviations.why: The framework never inspects a card's output, so a card that draws nothing needs a hook for tests and scripts; the brief allowed a hook on the contributed loop's output.

concerns: Test cards draw templates kept under tests/registry_models/templates/plugin_cards/, the only installed test app with an app-directories template path. A dedicated test templates directory would be cleaner but needs a settings change outside this story.

A further view of a card finds the record type's overview as the first mount built on OverviewPlaces. A record type that registers two such overviews would need the mount whose predicate admits the record to be chosen (decisions.md#d13).
